method.character_coordinates: Python Unicode characters, zero-based half-open source intervals; block surrounding whitespace trimmed
method.line_coordinates: One-based inclusive source lines including opening and closing marker lines
method.intact_definition: At least one output chunk from the same source contains the entire original block interval
method.inventory: Independent line regex inventory of closed backtick/tilde fences and header+delimiter pipe tables, restricted to six .md sources and blocks <=1200 characters
method.scope_distinction: Standard scope accepts opening fences indented at most three spaces; expanded scope also accepts indented MkDocs tab fences
method.limitations: Heuristic, not a rendering parser or human code-quality judgment. It does not fully parse nested lists, blockquotes, escaped pipes, or imported code macros. Several src fences contain external-code import directives, not expanded executable code. RST marker matches are heading underlines, not genuine Markdown code blocks.
method.production_boundary: Production imports PDF/TXT/MD; direct RST source chunking was limited to this offline course structure experiment.

rst_interpretation: Four RST underline lines match the Markdown fence pattern; all ten stored protected_block_split chunks occur in the three affected RST sources. These flags must not be used as real code-splitting quality or improvement evidence.
